summary: Verified the reported login bug fix end-to-end. Backend: added 4 focused tests for the normalization fix (messy uppercase+whitespace email, trailing-space password, unknown-email 401 with detail 'Invalid credentials', and register+login roundtrip with messy inputs). Full pytest suite = 23/23 PASS. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844) Playwright: (1) continue-user-btn lands on /app, (2) continue-admin-btn lands on /admin, (3) email/password form login with clean creds user@ecosort.demo/user123 -> /app, (4) form login with '  User@Ecosort.Demo  ' + 'user123 ' (leading/trailing space + capitalized) -> /app (frontend trim + backend normalize both working), (5) wrong password shows 'Invalid credentials' sonner toast and remains on /login, (6) regression: authenticated user visiting /admin is redirected to /app, (7) UI signup with messy inputs '  UI_<rand>@Waste2Worth.app  ' / ' pass1234 ' succeeds and lands on /app. All 7 UI assertions PASS. No 'invalid credentials' false-positive observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py register() checks duplicate via {email: req.email.lower()} but does NOT strip whitespace, whereas the insert uses .lower().strip(). Edge case: registering 'a@b.com' then '  a@b.com  ' -> duplicate check misses (finds no match with untrimmed key), then insert stores 'a@b.com' again -> two docs with same normalized email. Fix: use req.email.lower().strip() in the existing lookup too.
Passwords are stored/compared as plaintext (demo app, acceptable but flagged).

Login normalization only .strip()s password — users who genuinely include internal spaces are fine, but if a real password had a leading/trailing space by design it would now be un-authable. Acceptable trade-off for mobile UX.
seed_data_creation: Register tests create random emails prefixed qa_/rt_/UI_ ; not cleaned up (small volume, per prior agent convention).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login normalization fix is fully verified. New pytest cases: test_login_messy_email_uppercase_and_spaces, test_login_trailing_space_password, test_login_unknown_email_401, test_register_and_login_roundtrip_normalized. One code-review nit remains: register() duplicate-check does not strip whitespace before lookup — could yield duplicate rows for whitespace-padded emails.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/auth/login did an exact match on lowercased email but no strip on either email or password; register stored .lower() (no strip). Mobile keyboards auto-capitalize and can add trailing spaces, so form values sent to backend never matched the seeded row. Fix applied (email=req.email.lower().strip(), password=req.password.strip() in login; register also strips) is correct and verified. Frontend also trims and disables autoCapitalize/autoCorrect/spellCheck on the login inputs — belt-and-braces.
